faq.question: What is MenuPricesHub?
faq.answer: MenuPricesHub is a restaurant discovery platform that helps users find restaurant menu prices, nutrition information, opening hours, reviews, and dining options across different cities.

faq.question: How accurate are the menu prices on MenuPricesHub?
faq.answer: We regularly update restaurant menu prices and related information. However, prices may vary depending on the restaurant location, promotions, and local taxes.

faq.question: Does MenuPricesHub provide calorie and nutrition information?
faq.answer: Yes, many restaurant pages include calorie counts, nutrition facts, and food details to help users make informed dining choices.
